reason: I only buy software after a friend or another owner says they use it, and here I see no customers I can ask. $89 a month is almost a tenth of what I earn, so I will not risk it on something nobody I know uses.
objection: I cannot tell which of your plans I need, and only 1 to 5 companies pay, with no references. If I cannot ask a friend who uses it, I will not pay $89.
would_change_my_mind: A friend who runs a business like mine telling me they use it and it works, plus a cheaper plan for 1 or 2 people that is clearly the one for me.
